SYSTEMD_WORKING_DIR.description: Working directory that `EXEC_START` will be run from

SYSTEMD_ENV.description: Optional additional properties as key/value pairs

SYSTEMD_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install SYSTEMD. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

SYSTEMD_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading systemd binary or archive artifacts.

SYSTEMD_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying systemd available remote releases.

SYSTEMD_VERSION.description: Specific version of systemd to install (e.g., latest, lts, or exact version).
